title: Takdi Rawan Teriyan Chan Veeran Haye Ujri Sughra
body:
Takdi Rahvaan Teriyaan Chun Veeran Haye Ujri Sughra
<<DIVIDER>>
Naam Khuda Day
Vatna Tay Haye Naam Khuda Day
Ik Vari Pehra Pah
<<DIVIDER>>
Teray Qadam Nishan Tay Beh Gaiyan
Har Duk Nu Veeran Seh Gaiyan
Teray Qadam Nishan Tay Beh Gaiyan
Aaja Akbar
Kol Meray Aja Akbar
Kitay Muk Na Javan Sah
<<DIVIDER>>
Meh Sugra Noo Arman Veeran
Teray Sirr Mein Sehra Lavaangi
Meh Sugra Noo Arman Veeran
Vaag Pharaee
Devay Menu Vaag Pharaee
Teri Behn Noo Eho Chah
<<DIVIDER>>
Meh Naam Teray Di Tasbi Nu
Har Saah Nal Veeran Parnian
Meh Naam Teray Di Tasbi Nu
Veer Madinay
Behn Teri Veer Madinay
Haye Vaykay Teray Rah
